name: Ralph Ruthe
bio: Ralph Ruthe is a German cartoonist, comic artist, author, and musician who used to work for the German edition of MAD magazine.

credits.title: The Unicorn That Said No
credits.overview: In the Forest of Hearts, a little, sweepity, swoopity, swappity, sweet unicorn is born. But even though everyone is very lilacly-loving to it and constantly feeds it with sweet lucky clover, the little critter does not behave unicorn-like at all.
